authors.name: nridirect.uk Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our team of independent document specialists helps NRIs navigate OCI, passport and visa paperwork with precision.

editorial.how_we_test: We meticulously review official guidelines and continually test our own internal checklists against current application processing requirements. Our guides are fact-checked by our document specialists.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We charge a fee for our document-check and application-assistance services. We do not accept payment to expedite official government processing, which is impossible.
editorial.corrections: If you spot an error or outdated requirement in our guides, please contact us. We correct factual errors promptly and note significant updates at the top of the relevant guide.
